name: ComfyUI - Flux 2 Dev image + WAN 2.2 video

parameters.formDescription: Generates an image with Flux 2 Dev and, optionally, animates it with WAN 2.2 i2v. Results are saved in ComfyUI's output folder. Uses installed models only.

values.placeholder: a steel arch bridge over a river at dawn, photorealistic
video only: e.g. slow aerial drift forward, mist moving over the water

nodes.notes: comfyUrl: ComfyUI Desktop = :8000, manual install = :8188. If n8n runs in Docker use http://host.docker.internal:8000. fluxWeightDtype: fp8_e4m3fn for the full bf16 flux2-dev on <48 GB VRAM.
